        <h3>Find out how God made you. Then find out what for.</h3>
        <ul class="offer-list">
          <li style="--dot:var(--e)">Know exactly where your strengths and blind spots are, across all ten parts of your personality.</li>
          <li style="--dot:var(--n)">See where you really stand next to other people, and why they don't see things the way you do.</li>
          <li style="--dot:var(--a)">Understand the person you live with, and why you rub.</li>
          <li style="--dot:var(--c)">Leave with a clear next step for each part of you, not just a score.</li>
        </ul>
        <p class="offer-fine">The full Personality+ test: 100 research-tested questions, ten aspects scored against research norms, a guided walk through your results, a PDF report, and compare with someone you love.</p>
        <p class="offer-go">Take the full test →</p>
      </div>
      <div class="price">$9.99</div>
    </a>
    <div class="folio"><span>Made to Image · Sources: Heiser, The Unseen Realm (2015) and What Does God Want? (2018); IPIP; Scripture ESV</span><span>11</span></div>
    <svg class="scene dawn" id="more-dawn" viewBox="0 0 1440 480" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMax slice" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"></svg>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
  // Mini-IPIP, in the authors' interleaved order. Wording exactly as on ipip.ori.org/MiniIPIPKey.htm.
  const items = [
    ['Am the life of the party.', 'E', 0], ['Sympathize with others’ feelings.', 'A', 0],
    ['Get chores done right away.', 'C', 0], ['Have frequent mood swings.', 'N', 0],
    ['Have a vivid imagination.', 'O', 0], ['Don’t talk a lot.', 'E', 1],
    ['Am not interested in other people’s problems.', 'A', 1], ['Often forget to put things back in their proper place.', 'C', 1],
    ['Am relaxed most of the time.', 'N', 1], ['Am not interested in abstract ideas.', 'O', 1],
    ['Talk to a lot of different people at parties.', 'E', 0], ['Feel others’ emotions.', 'A', 0],
    ['Like order.', 'C', 0], ['Get upset easily.', 'N', 0],
    ['Have difficulty understanding abstract ideas.', 'O', 1], ['Keep in the background.', 'E', 1],
    ['Am not really interested in others.', 'A', 1], ['Make a mess of things.', 'C', 1],
    ['Seldom feel blue.', 'N', 1], ['Do not have a good imagination.', 'O', 1],
  ];
  const TRAIT_COLOR = {E: '#ed5362', N: '#9a338e', A: '#3a81cd', C: '#00c9b7', O: '#344b47'};
  const answers = (() => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mti:answers')) || {}; } catch (e) { return {}; } })();
  const tb = document.getElementById('items');
  items.forEach(([text, trait], i) => {
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    tr.innerHTML = `<td class="num">${i + 1}</td><td>${text}</td>` +
      [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => `<td class="o"><button type="button" class="bubble" data-i="${i}" data-n="${n}" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="${n}">${n}</button></td>`).join('');
    tb.appendChild(tr);
  });
  // The Easter egg: a picked number fills with its trait's color. Nothing on the page says which trait.
  function paintRow(i) {
    tb.querySelectorAll(`.bubble[data-i="${i}"]`).forEach((b) => {
      const on = answers[i] === +b.dataset.n;
      const c = TRAIT_COLOR[items[i][1]];
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on);
      b.style.background = on ? c : '';
      b.style.borderColor = on ? c : '';
      b.style.color = on ? (items[i][1] === 'C' ? '#15172b' : '#fff') : '';
    });
  }
  tb.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const b = e.target.closest('.bubble');
    if (!b) return;
    answers[+b.dataset.i] = +b.dataset.n;
    try { localStorage.setItem('mti:answers', JSON.stringify(answers)); } catch (err) {}
    paintRow(+b.dataset.i);
    renderGlimpse();
    renderMore();
    if (Object.keys(answers).length === items.length && !tb.dataset.done) { tb.dataset.done = '1'; track('self_check_complete'); }
  });
  items.forEach((_, i) => paintRow(i));
  // ---------- Trait pages: the guess slider sizes the trait square; answers are kept in this browser ----------
  const store = {
    get(k) { try { return localStorage.getItem('mti:' + k); } catch (e) { return null; } },
    set(k, v) { try { localStorage.setItem('mti:' + k, v); } catch (e) {} },
  };
  document.querySelectorAll('input[data-guess]').forEach((inp) => {
    const k = inp.dataset.guess;
    const sq = document.querySelector(`[data-sq="${k}"]`);
    const saved = store.get('guess-' + k);
    if (saved !== null) inp.value = saved;
    const size = () => { const px = 30 + 90 * (inp.value / 100); sq.style.width = sq.style.height = px + 'px'; };
    inp.addEventListener('input', () => { size(); store.set('guess-' + k, inp.value); });
    size();
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('textarea[data-save]').forEach((ta) => {
    const saved = store.get(ta.dataset.save);
    if (saved !== null) ta.value = saved;
    ta.addEventListener('input', () => store.set(ta.dataset.save, ta.value));
  });


  // ---------- Page 10: drag the reasons into "Comes hard" / "Comes easy" (tap also works) ----------
  (function () {
    const KEY = 'mti:love-buckets-2';
    let placed = {};
    try { placed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)) || {}; } catch (e) {}
    const chips = [...document.querySelectorAll('#love-rows .chip')];
    const byId = Object.fromEntries(chips.map((c) => [c.dataset.chip, c]));
    const buckets = Object.fromEntries([...document.querySelectorAll('.bucket')].map((b) => [b.dataset.bucket, b]));
    const save = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(placed)); } catch (e) {} };

    function render() {
      Object.values(buckets).forEach((b) => (b.querySelector('.bucket-items').innerHTML = ''));
      chips.forEach((c) => {
        const where = placed[c.dataset.chip];
        c.classList.toggle('placed', !!where);
        if (!where) return;
        const b = document.createElement('button');
        b.type = 'button';
        b.className = 'bchip';
        b.dataset.chip = c.dataset.chip;
        b.title = c.textContent;
        b.innerHTML = `<span class="dot" style="background:var(--${c.dataset.c})"></span>${c.dataset.line} <span class="bchip-k">${c.dataset.label}</span>`;
        buckets[where].querySelector('.bucket-items').appendChild(b);
      });
    }
    // tap: table → hard → easy → back to the table
    const cycle = (id) => {
      const next = {undefined: 'hard', hard: 'easy', easy: undefined}[placed[id]];
      if (next) placed[id] = next; else delete placed[id];
      save(); render();
    };

    let drag = null;
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      const el = e.target.closest('#love-rows .chip, .bchip');
      if (!el) return;
      drag = {id: el.dataset.chip, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, moved: false, ghost: null, touch: e.pointerType === 'touch'};
      if (e.pointerType !== 'touch' && el.setPointerCapture) el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    });
    document.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!drag || drag.touch) return;
      if (!drag.moved && Math.hypot(e.clientX - drag.x, e.clientY - drag.y) < 6) return;
      if (!drag.moved) {
        drag.moved = true;
        drag.ghost = document.createElement('div');
        drag.ghost.className = 'drag-ghost';
        const c = byId[drag.id];
        drag.ghost.innerHTML = `<span class="dot" style="background:var(--${c.dataset.c})"></span>${c.dataset.line} · ${c.dataset.label}`;
        document.body.appendChild(drag.ghost);
      }
      drag.ghost.style.left = e.clientX + 10 + 'px';
      drag.ghost.style.top = e.clientY + 10 + 'px';
      const over = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY)?.closest('.bucket');
      Object.values(buckets).forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle('over', b === over));
    });
    document.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
      if (drag && drag.ghost) drag.ghost.remove();
      drag = null;
      Object.values(buckets).forEach((b) => b.classList.remove('over'));
    });
    document.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => {
      if (!drag) return;
      const d = drag; drag = null;
      Object.values(buckets).forEach((b) => b.classList.remove('over'));
      if (!d.moved) { cycle(d.id); return; }
      d.ghost.remove();
      const over = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY)?.closest('.bucket');
      if (over) placed[d.id] = over.dataset.bucket;
      else if (!e.target.closest || !document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY)?.closest('.bucket')) {
        // dropped outside a bucket: a chip dragged out of a bucket goes back to the table
        if (document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY)?.closest('#love-rows')) delete placed[d.id];
      }
      save(); render();
    });
    // keyboard: Enter or Space on a chip moves it like a tap
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const el = e.target.closest('#love-rows .chip, .bchip');
      if (el && e.detail === 0) cycle(el.dataset.chip);
    });
    render();
  })();


  // ---------- Page 11: the top of the tree colored from the glimpse; the rest still "?" ----------
  function renderMore() {
    const T = ['E', 'N', 'A', 'C', 'O'];
    const done = Object.keys(answers).length === items.length;
    const raw = Object.fromEntries(T.map((k) => [k, 0]));
    items.forEach(([, k, rev], i) => { if (answers[i]) raw[k] += rev ? 6 - answers[i] : answers[i]; });
    const pct = (k) => (done ? ((raw[k] - 4) / 16) * 100 : 50);
    const gx = (t) => 63.2 + t * 140.4; // centers of the five grid columns below
    const rad = (v, m) => m * Math.sqrt(Math.max(10, v) / 100);
    let h = '<g stroke="#c3c6cc" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none">' +
      `<line x1="344" y1="92" x2="344" y2="108"/><line x1="${gx(0)}" y1="108" x2="${gx(4)}" y2="108"/>`;
    T.forEach((_, t) => (h += `<line x1="${gx(t)}" y1="108" x2="${gx(t)}" y2="176"/>`));
    h += '</g>';
    const vals = T.map((k) => Math.max(8, pct(k)));
    const tot = vals.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0);
    let ang = -Math.PI / 2;
    const R = 44, cx = 344, cy = 46;
    T.forEach((k, t) => {
      const a0 = ang; ang += (vals[t] / tot) * Math.PI * 2;
      const large = ang - a0 > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
      h += `<path d="M${cx},${cy} L${cx + R * Math.cos(a0)},${cy + R * Math.sin(a0)} A${R},${R} 0 ${large} 1 ${cx + R * Math.cos(ang)},${cy + R * Math.sin(ang)} Z" fill="${TRAIT_COLOR[k]}" stroke="#ebeced" stroke-width="2.5"/>`;
    });
    h += `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="30" fill="#ebeced"/><text x="${cx}" y="${cy + 1}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" font-family="Archivo, sans-serif" font-weight="850" font-stretch="125%" font-size="19" fill="#15172b">You</text>`;
    const names = ['Extraversion', 'Neuroticism', 'Agreeableness', 'Conscientiousness', 'Openness'];
    T.forEach((k, t) => {
      h += `<circle cx="${gx(t)}" cy="140" r="${rad(pct(k), 28)}" fill="${TRAIT_COLOR[k]}"/>` ;
    });
    document.getElementById('more-top').innerHTML = h;

    // below the ten boxes, the tree keeps going and fades out
    let f = '';
    T.forEach((_, t) => {
      [-26, 0, 26].forEach((dx, j) => {
        const x = gx(t) + dx;
        f += `<line x1="${gx(t)}" y1="0" x2="${x}" y2="34" stroke="#c3c6cc" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="3 4" opacity="${0.9 - j * 0.15}"/>` +
          `<circle cx="${x}" cy="44" r="${7 - Math.abs(dx) / 13}" fill="#c3c6cc" opacity="${0.55 - Math.abs(dx) / 120}"/>` +
          `<circle cx="${x}" cy="60" r="3" fill="#c3c6cc" opacity="${0.3 - Math.abs(dx) / 200}"/>`;
      });
    });
    document.getElementById('more-fade').innerHTML = f;
  }

  // ---------- Cover: four ABCD sliders move the threads and reshape the color wheel ----------
  // Illustration only, not scoring. Each slider pushes certain aspects up (or down).
  // The wheel, threads and mountains are rebuilt from the website's own drawings (Threads.tsx, Scene.tsx).
  (function () {
    const COLORS = ['#ed5362', '#9a338e', '#3a81cd', '#00c9b7', '#344b47']; // E N A C O
    const THREAD = (i) => (i === 4 ? '#6f9189' : COLORS[i]); // Openness ink is too dark on night
    // aspects in order: E(Enthusiasm, Assertiveness) N(Withdrawal, Volatility) A(Compassion, Politeness)
    //                   C(Industriousness, Orderliness) O(Interest in Ideas, Aesthetic Openness)
    const base = [52, 48, 45, 50, 55, 50, 50, 46, 52, 54];
    const pull = {
      emotions:    [0.5, 0, 0.7, 0.7, 0.4, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.2],
      behavior:    [0, 0.5, 0, 0, 0, 0.2, 0.7, 0.7, 0, 0],
      thinking:    [0.1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, -0.2, 0.8, 0.7],
      motivations: [0, -0.5, 0, 0, 0.6, 0.6, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    };
    const motion = !(window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches);
    const inputs = [...document.querySelectorAll('#tree input')];
    const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
    const el = (tag, attrs, parent) => { const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); for (const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); parent.appendChild(e); return e; };

    // --- the color wheel: five arcs that draw themselves in ---
    const root = document.getElementById('root');
    const R = 40, C = 2 * Math.PI * R;
    const arcs = COLORS.map((c) => el('circle', {class: 'wheel-arc', cx: 50, cy: 50, r: R, fill: 'none', stroke: c, 'stroke-width': 16, 'stroke-dasharray': `0 ${C}`}, root));
    el('text', {x: 50, y: 51, 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'dominant-baseline': 'middle', 'font-family': 'Archivo, sans-serif',
      'font-weight': 850, 'font-size': 19, 'font-stretch': '125%', fill: '#ffffff'}, root).textContent = 'You';
    let wheelReady = false;
    function drawWheel(tr) {
      const total = tr.reduce((x, y) => x + Math.max(4, y), 0);
      let a = -90;
      tr.forEach((v, i) => {
        const deg = (Math.max(4, v) / total) * 360;
        const len = (deg / 360) * C;
        arcs[i].style.transform = `rotate(${a}deg)`;
        if (wheelReady || !motion) arcs[i].style.strokeDasharray = `${Math.max(0, len - 1.2)} ${C}`;
        else arcs[i].dataset.dash = `${Math.max(0, len - 1.2)} ${C}`;
        a += deg;
      });
    }

    // --- the threads: ten threads, two per trait, woven through five knots ---
    const svg = document.getElementById('threads');
    const W = 600, H = 260, KNOT_X = [60, 180, 300, 420, 540], GAP = 10, STEP = 6;
    const SWELL = [-32, 38, -24, 32, -19];
    const knotY = (score, i) => Math.max(22, Math.min(H - 22, 130 + SWELL[i] - (Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score)) - 50) * 1.3));
    const centerY = (x, ys) => {
      const xs = [-60, ...KNOT_X, W + 60], pts = [ys[0], ...ys, ys[ys.length - 1]];
      let j = 0; while (j < xs.length - 2 && x > xs[j + 1]) j++;
      const u = (x - xs[j]) / (xs[j + 1] - xs[j]);
      const p0 = pts[Math.max(0, j - 1)], p1 = pts[j], p2 = pts[j + 1], p3 = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, j + 2)];
      const u2 = u * u, u3 = u2 * u;
      return 0.5 * (2 * p1 + (-p0 + p2) * u + (2 * p0 - 5 * p1 + 4 * p2 - p3) * u2 + (-p0 + 3 * p1 - 3 * p2 + p3) * u3);
    };
    const fan = (x) => {
      const xs = [-60, ...KNOT_X, W + 60];
      let j = 0; while (j < xs.length - 2 && x > xs[j + 1]) j++;
      const u = (x - xs[j]) / (xs[j + 1] - xs[j]);
      return Math.sin(Math.PI * u) * (j % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1);
    };
    const threadPath = (k, ys, t) => {
      const off = (k - 4.5) * GAP;
      let d = '';
      for (let x = -20; x <= W + 20; x += STEP) {
        const drift = t ? 6 * Math.sin(x / 85 + t * 0.9 + k * 0.22) : 0;
        const y = centerY(x, ys) + off * fan(x) + drift * Math.abs(fan(x));
        d += `${d ? 'L' : 'M'}${x} ${y.toFixed(1)}`;
      }
      return d;
    };
    const g = el('g', {fill: 'none', 'stroke-linecap': 'round'}, svg);
    const paths = Array.from({length: 10}, (_, k) => el('path', {stroke: THREAD(Math.floor(k / 2)), 'stroke-width': 2.2, opacity: k % 2 ? 0.75 : 1}, g));
    const knots = KNOT_X.map((x, i) => el('circle', {class: 'knot', r: 9, fill: THREAD(i), cx: 0, cy: 0}, svg));
    let target = [50, 50, 50, 50, 50].map(knotY), shown = [...target];
    const drawThreads = (t) => {
      knots.forEach((c, i) => c.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${KNOT_X[i]} ${shown[i].toFixed(1)})`));
      paths.forEach((p, k) => p.setAttribute('d', threadPath(k, shown, t)));
    };

    function update() {
      const s = Object.fromEntries(inputs.map((i) => [i.dataset.k, i.value / 100]));
      const asp = base.map((b, i) => Math.max(4, Math.min(98, b + 46 * Object.keys(pull).reduce((sum, k) => sum + pull[k][i] * s[k], 0))));
      const tr = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((t) => (asp[2 * t] + asp[2 * t + 1]) / 2);
      drawWheel(tr);
      target = tr.map((v, i) => knotY(v, i));
      if (!motion) { shown = [...target]; drawThreads(0); }
    }
    inputs.forEach((i) => i.addEventListener('input', update));
    update();
    shown = [...target];
    drawThreads(0);

    if (motion) {
      let frame = 0, visible = true;
      const start = performance.now();
      const tick = (now) => {
        shown = shown.map((y, i) => y + (target[i] - y) * 0.12);
        drawThreads((now - start) / 1000);
        frame = visible ? requestAnimationFrame(tick) : 0;
      };
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => { visible = e.isIntersecting; if (visible && !frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick); }).observe(svg);
      }
      // the wheel draws itself in, one color after another
      requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        arcs.forEach((a, i) => { a.style.transitionDelay = `${0.15 + i * 0.16}s`; a.style.strokeDasharray = a.dataset.dash; });
        wheelReady = true;
        setTimeout(() => arcs.forEach((a) => (a.style.transitionDelay = '0s')), 1800);
      }));
    }

    // --- the mountains and the red sun ---
    const scene = document.getElementById('cover-scene');
    const RIDGES = [
      '0,300 120,240 230,270 360,180 470,230 600,150 720,210 860,120 980,200 1100,160 1240,230 1440,170 1440,480 0,480',
      '0,360 150,290 280,330 420,250 560,320 700,260 820,300 960,230 1100,310 1260,250 1440,300 1440,480 0,480',
      '0,410 180,350 340,390 500,330 640,380 800,340 940,400 1120,350 1300,390 1440,360 1440,480 0,480',
      '0,450 200,420 420,440 620,410 860,445 1080,415 1300,440 1440,425 1440,480 0,480',
    ];
    const widen = (pts) => {
      const p = pts.split(' ');
      const first = p[0].split(',')[1], lastTop = p[p.length - 3].split(',')[1];
      return [`-120,${first}`, ...p.slice(0, -2), `1560,${lastTop}`, '1560,480', '-120,480'].join(' ');
    };
    const sun = el('g', {class: 'sun'}, scene);
    el('circle', {cx: 1035, cy: 175, r: 78}, sun);
    RIDGES.map(widen).forEach((pts, i) => {
      const lyr = el('g', {class: `lyr l${i + 1}`}, scene);
      el('polygon', {points: pts}, lyr);
      if (i < 3) el('rect', {class: 'fog', x: -120, y: 300 + i * 50, width: 1680, height: 40}, lyr);
    });
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scene.classList.add('in')));
  })();



  // ---------- Page 11: mountains at the top (night) and the close (dawn); they rise when scrolled into view ----------
  (function () {
    const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
    const el = (tag, attrs, parent) => { const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); for (const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); parent.appendChild(e); return e; };
    const RIDGES = [
      '0,300 120,240 230,270 360,180 470,230 600,150 720,210 860,120 980,200 1100,160 1240,230 1440,170 1440,480 0,480',
      '0,360 150,290 280,330 420,250 560,320 700,260 820,300 960,230 1100,310 1260,250 1440,300 1440,480 0,480',
      '0,410 180,350 340,390 500,330 640,380 800,340 940,400 1120,350 1300,390 1440,360 1440,480 0,480',
      '0,450 200,420 420,440 620,410 860,445 1080,415 1300,440 1440,425 1440,480 0,480',
    ];
    const widen = (pts) => {
      const p = pts.split(' ');
      const first = p[0].split(',')[1], lastTop = p[p.length - 3].split(',')[1];
      return [`-120,${first}`, ...p.slice(0, -2), `1560,${lastTop}`, '1560,480', '-120,480'].join(' ');
    };
    const build = (svg, sun) => {
      if (sun) el('circle', {cx: sun[0], cy: sun[1], r: 78}, el('g', {class: 'sun'}, svg));
      RIDGES.map(widen).forEach((pts, i) => {
        const lyr = el('g', {class: `lyr l${i + 1}`}, svg);
        el('polygon', {points: pts}, lyr);
        if (i < 3) el('rect', {class: 'fog', x: -120, y: 300 + i * 50, width: 1680, height: 40}, lyr);
      });
      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => { if (e.isIntersecting) { svg.classList.add('in'); io.disconnect(); } }, {threshold: 0.2});
        io.observe(svg);
      } else svg.classList.add('in');
    };
    build(document.getElementById('more-night'), [420, 190]);
    build(document.getElementById('more-dawn'), [1000, 210]);
  })();

  // ---------- Drop-off tracking hooks ----------
  // Nothing is sent anywhere yet. When the workbook moves to the website, point window.mtiTrack at the
  // site's analytics tool and these events start counting: who opens it, how far they get, and who clicks to buy.
  // When the workbook sits on the website (in a frame under the site header), the site is its host:
  // tracking goes to the site's tracker, and buy links open in the same tab instead of a new one.
  const host = (() => { try { return window.frameElement && window.frameElement.dataset.site === 'pp' ? window.parent : null; } catch (e) { return null; } })();
  const track = (event, data) => {
    try {
      const sink = window.mtiTrack || (host && host.mtiTrack);
      if (sink) sink(event, data || {}); else console.info('[track]', event, data || '');
    } catch (e) {}
  };
  if (host) {
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const a = e.target.closest('a[href^="https://discoverpersonalityplus.com/"]');
      if (!a) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      host.location.href = a.getAttribute('href').replace('https://discoverpersonalityplus.com', '');
    });
  }
  track('open');
  let touched = false;
  document.addEventListener('input', () => { if (!touched) { touched = true; track('first_interaction'); } }, true);
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!touched && e.target.closest('button, input')) { touched = true; track('first_interaction'); }
    const a = e.target.closest('[data-track]');
    if (a) track(a.dataset.track, {where: a.dataset.where});
  }, true);
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => entries.forEach((en) => {
      if (!en.isIntersecting) return;
      const n = [...document.querySelectorAll('.page')].indexOf(en.target) + 1;
      if (!seen.has(n)) { seen.add(n); track('reached_page', {page: n}); }
    }), {threshold: 0, rootMargin: '0px 0px -50% 0px'}); // a page counts once its top reaches the middle of the screen
    document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach((pg) => io.observe(pg));
  }


  // ---------- Page 9: score the self-check and draw the glimpse ----------
  function renderGlimpse() {
    // on the night panel, Openness ink is too dark, so it uses the same lighter tint as the threads
    const NC = Object.assign({}, TRAIT_COLOR, {O: '#6f9189'});
    const T = [['E', 'Extraversion'], ['N', 'Neuroticism'], ['A', 'Agreeableness'], ['C', 'Conscientiousness'], ['O', 'Openness']];
    const done = Object.keys(answers).length;
    const complete = done === items.length;
    // raw totals 4–20 (reverse-keyed items flipped), then 0–100 for drawing
    const raw = Object.fromEntries(T.map(([k]) => [k, 0]));
    items.forEach(([, k, rev], i) => { if (answers[i]) raw[k] += rev ? 6 - answers[i] : answers[i]; });
    const pct = (k) => ((raw[k] - 4) / 16) * 100;
    const band = (v) => (v < 37.5 ? 'lower' : v < 68.75 ? 'in the middle' : 'higher'); // 4–9, 10–14, 15–20
    const guessBand = (v) => (v < 34 ? 'lower' : v <= 66 ? 'in the middle' : 'higher');


    // two sides of one trait: the trait nearest the middle, the two ways it can split, and the gift of each
    const SPLITS = {
      E: ['Enthusiasm', 'Assertiveness', ['Warm, but not out front', 'You light up around people and good things, but you would rather not be the one in charge.', 'Your warmth and joy draw people in and make them feel welcome.'], ['Out front, but not bubbly', 'You take charge and make things happen, but you don\u2019t run on big, visible excitement.', 'You are decisive and steady; you can lead without needing the room to be fun.']],
      N: ['Withdrawal', 'Volatility', ['Stress that goes inward', 'When stress comes, you pull inward: worry, second-guessing and holding back, more than anger.', 'You think before you react, and you notice risks early.'], ['Stress that comes out', 'When stress comes, it comes out: frustration rises fast, though you don\u2019t dwell in worry.', 'You face problems head-on, and you will defend yourself and the people you love.']],
      A: ['Compassion', 'Politeness', ['A big heart with a blunt edge', 'You care deeply about people, but you don\u2019t soften your words or bow to rules for their own sake.', 'You show up when people are hurting, and you will tell them the hard truth they need.'], ['Courteous, but not easily moved', 'You are respectful and follow the rules, but other people\u2019s pain moves you less than most.', 'You treat people fairly, keep the peace and honor those in charge.']],
      C: ['Industriousness', 'Orderliness', ['Hard work in a messy room', 'You work hard and push toward goals, but order and routine don\u2019t come naturally.', 'You get things done, and you finish what you start.'], ['Organized, but slow to launch', 'You like things planned, neat and done right, but steady drive is harder to find.', 'You bring structure, and you notice when things are out of place.']],
      O: ['Interest in Ideas', 'Aesthetic Openness', ['A thinker more than a feeler', 'You love ideas, arguments and figuring things out, but art and imagination draw you less.', 'You reason clearly and enjoy hard problems; understanding is its own reward to you.'], ['A feeler more than a thinker', 'Beauty, imagination and feeling move you deeply, but abstract debate draws you less.', 'You notice patterns, beauty and emotion that others miss.']],
    };
    const pick = complete ? T.map(([k]) => k).sort((x, y) => Math.abs(raw[x] - 12) - Math.abs(raw[y] - 12))[0] : 'A';
    const pName = T.find(([k]) => k === pick)[1];
    const [as1, as2, sideA, sideB] = SPLITS[pick];
    const lead = complete
      ? `God made every trait with two sides, and they don\u2019t always match. Your <b>${pName}</b> came out <b>${band(pct(pick))}</b>. Its two sides are ${as1} and ${as2}, and two people with your score can be equipped very differently:`
      : `God made every trait with two sides, and they don\u2019t always match. Two people with the same ${pName} score can be equipped very differently:`;
    document.getElementById('unseen').innerHTML =
      `<h3>Two sides of every trait</h3><p>${lead}</p>
      <div class="pair">
        <div class="side" style="--side:${NC[pick]}"><strong>${sideA[0]}</strong><span>${sideA[1]}</span><em class="work"><b>The gift:</b> ${sideA[2]}</em></div>
        <div class="side" style="--side:${NC[pick]}"><strong>${sideB[0]}</strong><span>${sideB[1]}</span><em class="work"><b>The gift:</b> ${sideB[2]}</em></div>
      </div>
      <p>These two gifts work differently. If you don\u2019t know which gifts you carry, you can spend years never reaching what God equipped you for.</p><p>If you want to keep discovering how God put you together, understand your gifts and see where you can grow, the full test will walk you through it.</p>
      <a class="go" href="https://discoverpersonalityplus.com/buy?utm_source=made-to-image&utm_medium=freebie&utm_content=glimpse" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-track="buy_click" data-where="glimpse">Discover your gifts · $9.99</a>`;
    document.getElementById('g-status').innerHTML = complete ? ''
      : `<b>Answer all 20 on page 8 to rediscover who you are.</b> ${done} of 20 answered.`;

    // tree: You wheel → five traits → ten parts still unknown
    const svg = document.getElementById('g-tree');
    const gx = (t) => 68.8 + t * 137.6;
    const rad = (v, m) => m * Math.sqrt(Math.max(8, v) / 100);
    let h = '<g stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.25)" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none">' +
      `<line x1="344" y1="62" x2="344" y2="84"/><line x1="${gx(0)}" y1="84" x2="${gx(4)}" y2="84"/>`;
    T.forEach((_, t) => {
      h += `<polyline points="${gx(t)},84 ${gx(t)},120"/><polyline points="${gx(t)},120 ${gx(t)},170 ${gx(t) - 34},170 ${gx(t) - 34},200"/>` +
        `<polyline points="${gx(t)},170 ${gx(t) + 34},170 ${gx(t) + 34},200"/>`;
    });
    h += '</g>';
    // wheel
    const vals = T.map(([k]) => (complete ? Math.max(8, pct(k)) : 20));
    const tot = vals.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0);
    let ang = -Math.PI / 2;
    const R = 46, cx = 344, cy = 46;
    T.forEach(([k], t) => {
      const a0 = ang; ang += (vals[t] / tot) * Math.PI * 2;
      const large = ang - a0 > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
      const fill = complete ? NC[k] : '#2a3a63';
      h += `<path d="M${cx},${cy} L${cx + R * Math.cos(a0)},${cy + R * Math.sin(a0)} A${R},${R} 0 ${large} 1 ${cx + R * Math.cos(ang)},${cy + R * Math.sin(ang)} Z" fill="${fill}" stroke="#0b1226" stroke-width="2.5"/>`;
    });
    h += `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="31" fill="#0b1226"/><text x="${cx}" y="${cy + 1}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" font-family="Archivo, sans-serif" font-weight="850" font-stretch="125%" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff">You</text>`;
    T.forEach(([k], t) => {
      const r = complete ? rad(pct(k), 30) : 16;
      h += `<circle cx="${gx(t)}" cy="120" r="${r}" fill="${complete ? NC[k] : '#2a3a63'}"/>`;
      [-34, 34].forEach((dx) => {
        h += `<circle cx="${gx(t) + dx}" cy="206" r="17" fill="#1e2c51"/><text x="${gx(t) + dx}" y="207" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" font-family="Archivo, sans-serif" font-weight="850" font-size="15" fill="#b9bfd6">?</text>`;
      });
    });
    svg.innerHTML = h;

    // one row per trait: square, name and read, meter with score and guess
    document.getElementById('g-rows').innerHTML = T.map(([k, name]) => {
      const g = document.querySelector(`input[data-guess="${k.toLowerCase()}"]`);
      const gv = g ? +g.value : 50;
      const v = pct(k);
      const size = complete ? 18 + 0.34 * v : 30;
      const read = complete
        ? `Your answers lean <b>${band(v)}</b>. You guessed <b>${guessBand(gv)}</b>.`
        : 'Waiting on your answers.';
      return `<div class="g-row">
        <div class="g-sqbox"><div class="g-sq" style="width:${size}px;height:${size}px;background:${complete ? NC[k] : '#2a3a63'}"></div></div>
        <div><div class="g-name">${name}</div><div class="g-read">${read}</div></div>
        <div class="g-meter"><div class="g-track">
          <span class="g-guess" style="left:calc(7px + (100% - 14px) * ${gv / 100})" title="Your guess"></span>
          ${complete ? `<span class="g-mark" style="left:calc(8px + (100% - 16px) * ${v / 100});background:${NC[k]}" title="Your answers"></span>` : ''}
        </div><div class="g-ends"><span>Lower</span><span>Middle</span><span>Higher</span></div></div>
      </div>`;
    }).join('') +
      '<div class="g-key"><span><i class="g-mark-k"></i>Your answers</span><span><i class="g-guess-k"></i>Your guess from pages 3–7</span></div>';
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('input[data-guess]').forEach((inp) => inp.addEventListener('input', renderGlimpse));
  renderGlimpse();
  renderMore();
</script>
